north_star: WillieOS Subscription Amplifier: A portable layer that turns the AI subscriptions you already pay for into a council. You ask once. Gary asks Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, v0 — whichever ones you've subscribed to. Gary synthesizes their views, picks the best path, and executes the work using the same subscriptions. You see what each model said. You see why Gary chose. You get the deliverable.

entries.title: Council under-load verification — gemini PTY fix shipped
entries.summary: Fired 1KB + 5KB council tests. Gemini was ok=false (1KB) and timeout (5KB) due to missing PTY wrapping — same pattern as codex/grok. Fix: added usePty to gemini adapter. Grok 5KB timeout is model speed, not infra. All adapter tests pass.

entries.title: Cowork bridge dispatch-claim — status mismatch + heartbeat fix
entries.summary: Session 10 incorrectly called WAI. Session 12 found 3 real bugs: cowork dispatches created as pending (not dispatched), no heartbeat written during polling, liveness check missed heartbeat signal. Fixed all three + 4 tests.

entries.title: Session 13 — phaseRunner settings trigger fix + cowork liveness + council wizard redirect
entries.summary: Three fixes: (1) phaseRunner missing _meta.version broke settings trigger on every multi-phase dispatch, (2) cowork liveness missed running/dispatched dispatches, (3) 'council wizard' phrases had no redirect after tool deletion. 7 new tests, 64 green.

entries.title: Classifier — customer deliverables route to Council fan-out
entries.summary: Three new signal detectors (multi_website_reference, voice_sensitive, multi_section_deliverable). selectShape promotes customer_deliverable with signalCount >= 5 to 4-chain. Megaport hero prompt: 2-chain → 4-chain. 44 tests green.
